description: This file contains functions related to bucketing passes for FSDP (Fully Sharded Data Parallel) operations within PyTorch's FX graph manipulation framework. It primarily defines bucketing strategies for all_gather and reduce_scatter operations, with external references to torch FX nodes and bucketing utilities.

methods.name: bool is_graph_input(node: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Checks if a FX node is a graph input placeholder.

methods.name: bool is_fsdp_all_gather_wait(wait: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Determines if a FX node is an all_gather wait node associated with FSDP.

methods.name: bool is_graph_output(node: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Checks if a FX node is an output node in the graph.

methods.name: bool is_fsdp_reduce_scatter_wait(wait: torch.fx.Node)
methods.description: Determines if a FX node is a reduce_scatter wait node associated with FSDP.

methods.name: None bucket_fsdp_all_gather( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, bucket_cap_mb_by_bucket_idx: Callable[[int], float] | None = None, mode: BucketMode = "default", )
methods.description: Performs bucketing for all_gather FSDP operations in a FX graph module.

methods.name: None bucket_fsdp_reduce_scatter( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, bucket_cap_mb_by_bucket_idx: Callable[[int], float] | None = None, mode: BucketMode = "default", )
methods.description: Performs bucketing for reduce_scatter FSDP operations in a FX graph module.

ctags.signature: ( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, bucket_cap_mb_by_bucket_idx: Callable[[int], float] | None = None, mode: BucketMode = "default", )

ctags.signature: ( gm: torch.fx.GraphModule, bucket_cap_mb_by_bucket_idx: Callable[[int], float] | None = None, mode: BucketMode = "default", )
